visualCharacteristics.purpose: Contained call-to-action banner: heading, short copy and a button beside an icon box
visualCharacteristics.layout: Text column (~75%) on a blue gradient beside a dark icon box (~25%) on desktop; stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: One row, two columns. column 1: heading, paragraph(s), CTA link in its own paragraph; column 2: icon image (picture only). Column order may be swapped; the picture-only column is the icon

usage: Inline promo/CTA banner (e.g. replacement parts, contact) within product or content pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single heading + CTA beside an icon. For a statement beside a stat graphic use columns-stat.
